text:
Marta: Hey team — final prep for Wed's hybrid joint webinar with NimbleTech. Quick sync: speakers, demos, AV, and swag bundling. Sam from NimbleTech is on this thread. Can folks confirm availability for a 30m run-through Monday 9am PT?
Sam (NimbleTech): Yep we're good. We'll demo the NitroEdge box + the cloud marketplace listing. Planning for a 10–12min live device demo. Who's owning fallback if the box flakes?
Ryan: I can own cloud fallback. I'll stand up a hosted demo image and a telemetry webhook. Need Nimble's model snapshot by Friday to pre-load KV cache.
Anika: Ship timeline: swag boxes go out Fri morning. Need final attendee list by Tue EOD. Are we sending physical demo kits to external speakers or just panelists?
Marta: Speakers get full demo kits + one spare for the booth. @Emma can you confirm shipping address workflow and customs notes for EU?
Emma: Confirmed — we'll use ShipEasy for international shipping. Please DM final addresses by Mon 3pm PT. Also arranging on-site AV; we need final slides by Tue noon.
Paul: Marketing asks for a marketplace offer code on the CTA slide. Can we lock a code by Fri so marketing can build the landing?
Sam (NimbleTech): Partner marketing will generate the code. I'll post it here as soon as it's available.
Ryan: For failover, proposed routing: primary -> Nimble device (local); fallback -> Redwood hosted variant. Quick runbook snippet: 
```bash
# pseudo-runbook
if demo.healthcheck fails then
  switch-hosted-demo --variant=redwood-lite
fi
```
Marta: Nice. Draft run-of-show below (short):
```text
00:00 intro 3m
03:00 product story 7m
10:00 Nimble device demo 12m
22:00 hosted fallback demo 5m
27:00 Q&A 8m
```
Anika: Moderator script is drafted — will share in #events-docs. Also asking booth ops to bring spare HDMI dongles, a USB-C hub, and a small managed ethernet switch.
Emma: AV test window Mon 8:30am PT — please be on Zoom by 8:25. I'll send the calendar invites and a dial-in for Nimble's AV tech.
Paul: Marketing needs a 30s partner promo clip by Tue noon for pre-roll. Sam, can Nimble produce a short product clip?
Sam (NimbleTech): Yes — will attach final clip + marketplace CTA image by Tue 11am.
Marta: :thumbsup: Thanks all. Owners: Ryan (fallback infra), Anika (swag + moderator), Emma (AV + shipping), Paul (marketplace CTA). Can each owner post a quick check-in by Mon 10am PT? I'll consolidate into a single checklist and drop it here.
